title: Billing creates a vendor bill from a confirmed purchase order, enters the bill date, confirms it and pays it in full
_seedNote: a purchase order with something to bill (the purchasing journeys confirm orders of ordered-quantity products). Billing reads purchase orders (Purchasing.Reader): the row opens PurchaseOrder_View (C1-01).

seeds.name: orderNo
seeds.sql: SELECT o.Number AS n FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrder AS o WHERE o.BillingStatus = 'ToInvoice' AND o.Status = 'PurchaseOrder' ORDER BY o.Number DESC LIMIT 1

steps.name: Open Purchase > RFQs & orders: the order is listed
Open the order: the read-only view with Create bill
Create bill: a draft vendor bill opens
Enter the bill date and confirm: numbered BILL/
Register payment for the whole amount due

outcome.label: the order's newest bill is posted and paid, and the order reads fully billed
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(i.ID) AS n FROM Invoicing.Invoice AS i WHERE i.ID = (SELECT MAX(x.ID) FROM Invoicing.Invoice AS x WHERE x.SourceDocument = '{{orderNo}}') AND i.InvoiceType = 'VendorBill' AND i.Status = 'Posted' AND i.PaymentStatus = 'Paid' AND i/Invoicing.Invoice_PurchaseOrder/Purchasing.PurchaseOrder/BillingStatus = 'FullyInvoiced'
